note: Graveborn Gravecaller (unit identity, Graveborn): a hunched caster in a three-tiered burial robe to the ground hemmed in violet, a grave-iron mantle with candle stubs, a deep drooping hood over a gilt death mask, a team vestment, bare bone arms in bell sleeves and a lit soul-light lantern held out on a crook. Tier II iron plate, tier III black gilt plate and a gilt halo; no flag on the back.
